fieldValues.title: Our essays about the work do not present the stack
fieldValues.statement: The essays I write about our work should be dogfood, and a blog post or essay should be a presentation of the stack. Today the theory of change and other essays live as records in muSrs, but nothing on our websites shows them from those records: the muDemocracy site's essay component only wraps hand-placed prose, its publishing script has no essay step, and semanticops.com has no essay page at all. So a person who reads our argument never meets the stack the argument is about.
source_ref: muDemocracy.org: src/components/Essay.astro, scripts/publish-musrs.mjs; muSrs holds four essay records, among them theory of change 7da63d85
semanticops.com: src/components and src/pages hold no essay view
